summary: Plan grill of platform-base across two ledgered Codex cold-read rounds (gpt-5.6-terra @ xhigh). Round 1 raised six decisions (frontend split, quality-gate ordering, freshness-pill truthfulness, Inter font source, API surface, audit definition) plus five factual plan gaps; round 2, run after the spec was tightened, found the plan lagging the spec's new precision. All resolved by plan edits, decision 0012, and a rebuilt nine-task decomposition. Rounds 1 and 3-5 in the ledger belong to the requirements gate run in the same session.
gaps: The plan's task graph and the canonical decomposition disagreed: the plan named nine tasks while the recorded decomposition had six, omitting quality-gate-baseline, api-surface-trim and frontend-foundation, so implementation would have started the frontend before its planned dependencies
frontend-foundation had been dropped from the decomposition, merging toolchain, token theme, primitives, shell, login, state layer and tests into one unbounded user-facing task
The repo-wide quality gate was scheduled last, so the frontend would be written before verify.py could enforce lint, format or typecheck
The data-freshness pill had no truthful value available: the story excludes ingestion and any freshness API
Inter was promised as self-hosted with no external fetch, but no font binaries exist in the repo and the _ds export imports Google Fonts
harness-wiring's decomposition entry had no write scope, tests, verify commands or reviewer focus, so it was not delegable
The plan omitted the confirmed placeholder Dashboard-only behaviour, the falsifiable warehouse proof, and the provenance carve-out for the Pulse-free scan
The plan said only 'auth, CSRF and health' where the spec carries an exact method/path/environment allow-list, leaving T6's complete-allow-list test with no complete list to assert
The plan directed localhost:3000 while the spec requires the literal 127.0.0.1 throughout the mock-OTP profile, and assigned no owner for warehouse-seed, the fixture total, or the DI-resolved E2E
The plan required only 'an OTP login per the Claude Design' where the spec makes the login layout, copy, input semantics, focus, live regions, motion and both viewports acceptance-critical
T9 mentioned .github/ without committing to CI running root verification on every push
contradictions: The plan's Task Decomposition had been rewritten from five to seven tasks after the human approved it, so the live plan no longer matched its approval digest and no decomposition could be recorded against it
The plan's allow-list omitted POST /api/auth/refresh while also retaining the vendored session stack 'as-is', which would silently reduce sessions to the 15-minute access-token lifetime
The recorded plan grill attested a stale input digest (1c8c...) against a plan that had since changed (428d...), so the existing approval could not be treated as valid
resolutions: The decomposition is rebuilt to nine tasks matching the plan's graph exactly, with tasks 1-4 left byte-identical so the shipped stages' contract hashes do not move

frontend-foundation is restored as its own not-user-facing predecessor owning scaffold, token theme, vendored Inter, shadcn primitives, the TanStack Query provider and the frontend quality gate; frontend-shell-login depends on it and owns only shell, login and auth UI

quality-gate-baseline is inserted ahead of all new code: ESLint + Prettier for backend and contract, and the four FACTORY_* commands in .envrc; the gate widens in frontend-foundation and is proven whole-workspace in harness-wiring
The freshness pill renders explicitly unavailable until the ingestion capability owns a real value, consistent with the four inactive nav items and the disabled search
Inter is vendored as licensed WOFF2 under frontend/ loaded via next/font/local, with an offline production build as the proof; next/font/google is explicitly rejected
harness-wiring gains write scope, acceptance criteria, verify commands, plan contracts and reviewer focus, and is reduced to wiring and proving the gate rather than inventing it

The plan gains the Dashboard-only shell behaviour, the falsifiable warehouse criterion, and a Pulse-free scan scoped to product identifiers that explicitly excludes VENDORED_FROM and provenance history per decision 0010

T6 is bound to the spec's allow-list and local runtime contract as normative, including refresh, the non-production-only Swagger document routes, the production prohibition, and the typed enveloped health response
The literal 127.0.0.1 profile is made binding, and warehouse-seed, the fixture total of 42 and the DI-resolved WAREHOUSE/SelectionExecutor proof are all assigned to api-surface-trim
T8 is bound to the spec's normative Login screen contract and to functional checks at 1440x900 and 390x844, with the mobile drawer closing on Escape and restoring focus
T9 explicitly adds or adjusts the product CI workflow so root verification runs on every push
Decision 0012 records the time-bounded vendored-API deviation; the audit criterion is restated as application-enforced and fail-closed with DB-level immutability deferred to decision 0011 / D-0003

rounds.question: The approved plan splits the frontend into `frontend-foundation` (scaffold + theme + quality gate, no screens) then `frontend-shell-login` (shell + login UI). The recorded decomposition dropped the foundation task and merged both. How do we reconcile?
options: Keep it merged, amend the plan
